snippet.title: Behind the Scenes of Genshin Impact "Let's Start With Nod-Krai" | Genshin Impact #NodKrai
snippet.description:
"The trinity of moon goddesses have long since faded into the shadows of time, and a new moon is set to rise..."
Follow the Genshin Impact team to learn more about the behind-the-scenes story of Nod-Krai's creation and the new "Song of the Welkin Moon" series.

About the New Version - 00:00:00
How will the story of the "Song of the Welkin Moon" version unfold... - 00:03:43
And just who will you meet in Nod-Krai? - 00:06:13
Are there any real-world archetypes that can encompass the design of this region? - 00:11:21
Is there anything you'd like to share about the future...? - 00:15:53

Thank you to all Travelers for your support and company along this journey. Stay tuned for more updates on Nod-Krai!
